_description: Industrial Control System (ICS), SCADA, OT, and critical-infrastructure targeting. Detects discussion of exposed PLCs/HMIs, ICS-specific malware families, vendor-specific vulnerabilities (Siemens / Schneider / Rockwell / Mitsubishi), and direct internet-facing ICS access listings. Highest-value pack for energy, manufacturing, utilities, oil & gas, and water sectors.

rules._description: ICS-specific malware families - Industroyer, Triton/Trisis, Pipedream, CrashOverride, Stuxnet variants, Fuxnet, BlackEnergy, IronGate. These are rare and high-impact; mere mention in a sale or operational-distribution context is critical.
rules._fp_risk: Low. ICS malware family names are distinctive and rarely appear outside threat-intelligence discussion.
rules._severity_rationale: Critical - operational ICS malware threatens physical safety and continuity of essential services.
rules.name: ICS - operational ICS malware mention

rules._description: Vulnerabilities or exploits targeting ICS vendor products. Two-signal lookahead: ICS vendor/product term + vulnerability/exploit/access term. Vendors covered: Siemens, Schneider, Rockwell, Mitsubishi, Honeywell, Yokogawa, GE Digital, Emerson, Phoenix Contact, Beckhoff, ABB.
rules._fp_risk: Medium. Mature ICS-CERT advisories use overlapping language - excludes pin ICS-CERT / Dragos / Claroty research framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - ICS vendor vulnerabilities have outsized real-world impact.
rules.name: ICS - vendor product vulnerability

rules._description: Direct access to ICS/OT assets for sale - exposed PLC/HMI/RTU access, plant network access, OT VPN. Two-signal lookahead: ICS-asset term + sale/access/exposed language.
rules._fp_risk: Low. ICS-access-sale jargon is very distinctive.
rules._severity_rationale: Critical - direct OT access enables physical impact attacks.
rules.name: ICS - OT / plant network access for sale

rules._description: Discussion of internet-exposed ICS via Shodan/Censys/Zoomeye searches against ICS protocols (Modbus, DNP3, BACnet, S7Comm, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA). Two-signal lookahead: search engine + ICS protocol term.
rules._fp_risk: Medium. Security researchers and Shodan blog use similar language - excludes pin research framing.
rules._severity_rationale: Medium-high - exposed-ICS reconnaissance is the first step toward targeting; aggregated lists indicate active campaigns.
rules.name: ICS - exposed device enumeration

rules._description: Critical-infrastructure sector targeting - energy/grid/water/oil&gas + cyber-attack language. Two-signal lookahead: sector term + targeting/disruption language.
rules._fp_risk: Medium. News coverage of nation-state activity uses similar language - excludes pin obvious news framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - sector-targeting chatter indicates campaign preparation against critical infrastructure.
rules.name: ICS - critical infrastructure sector targeting
